title: AI Use by Country 2026: Adoption Across the World - research data
compiled_by: Report AI research agent (read-only; nothing written to WordPress)

confidence_key.HIGH: primary source or primary dataset opened

primary_metric_definition: Microsoft AI user share = share of people aged 15-64 who used a generative AI product during the period, from anonymised Microsoft telemetry adjusted for OS/device share, internet penetration and population (technical paper arXiv 2511.02781).
